title: Frosted glass digit clock tick
summary: Four giant frosted glass digits in a two-row clock layout over a soft blurred colour field; the last digit steps once per second. Refraction through the glyphs makes a static frame feel premium and alive.
use_when: A countdown or timer moment before a launch or deadline
A premium, calm loop for a social post or a hero background
A stat beat where one number ticks up in whole steps
A silent autoplay tile with no copy beyond the number

look.type_style: geometric grotesk numerals, bold, tabular, stacked two rows of two digits, each digit ~40 % of frame height wide-set, colon as two round dots at the left edge; glyphs are frosted glass with a 1 px light rim

sfx.event: last digit steps to the next value (every 30 fr)

structure.shot: four frosted glass digits, hours on top, minutes below with a dot colon, over a soft peach, blue and lilac blurred field
structure.camera: static (motion.json drift 2 px/s @1920, zoom -0.1 %/s, not visible)
structure.motion: everything holds; refraction inside the glyphs is fixed; last digit steps at f30 in 1 fr (easings.stepped(1)), measured on a 30 fps strip

structure.shot: same clock, last digit one step higher; its refraction pattern differs with the new glyph shape
structure.motion: hold 30 fr; next step at f60, 1 fr swap (easings.stepped(1)) (±0.25 s from sheets, f30 swap measured)

structure.shot: same clock, last digit one step higher
structure.motion: hold 30 fr; step at f90 (easings.stepped(1), ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: same clock, last digit one step higher
structure.motion: hold 30 fr; step at f120 (easings.stepped(1), ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: last digit at its highest value, then on the final frame both minute digits roll over to the next ten
structure.motion: hold 30 fr; at f150 (last frame) tens and units step together in 1 fr (easings.stepped(1), ±0.25 s)

params.brand: any brand.json: bg and accent feed the blurred colour field, display font for the numerals
params.content.start: clock value at frame 0, four digits (hh:mm or any 4-digit count)
params.content.step: increment per tick (default +1 on the last digit, carries to the tens)
params.timing.tickFrames: frames between ticks at 30 fps (default 30 = 1 s)
params.timing.ticks: number of ticks (default 5; length = ticks x tickFrames + 1)
params.glass.refraction: strength of the displacement that bends the field through each glyph
params.aspect: 4:5 default; 1:1 and 9:16 keep the 2x2 stack, 16:9 lays out one row
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured on a 30 fps strip (0.70-1.70 s): the digit swap is a 1-frame step at f30, no roll, no fade, no scale. Ticks every 30 fr (1.00, 2.00, 3.00, 4.00, 5.00 s); the 5.00 tick is the last frame and carries into the tens digit. Background field is static (2 px/s drift, -0.1 %/s zoom from motion.json). Not loopable: the end value differs from the start. Proposed term: frosted-glyph (glyphs as frosted refractive glass with a light rim). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
